payload.hypothesis: Not a code defect but an unsatisfiable surface list: spec.touched_surfaces names toy/test/offset.test.js while the decomposer excluded that path from impl-offset's owned_surfaces (build-implement.js has the separate test-author node write acceptance tests to .artifacts/tests/impl-offset/), and because the lens prompt is built from specText alone and never sees task.owned_surfaces, spec_conformance re-derives the same missing-file finding every round while the fixer is forbidden to create the file — so the loop can only repeat, never converge.
history: r1: overruled spec_conformance at toy/test/offset.test.js|missing-file: the finding conflates two documents' surface lists — the spec's touched_surfaces names toy/test/offset.test.js as a placeholder for wherever the offset acceptance tests would live, but per .claude/workflows/build-implement.js the test-author node (a separate parallel agent, not the implementer) writes acceptance tests to .artifacts/tests/impl-offset/, never into toy/test/; the decomposition in .artifacts/c1-build-spec.json scopes impl-offset's owned_surfaces to toy/src/app.js, toy/test/integration-r5.test.js and toy/README.md only. Verified: npm test in toy/ passes 35/35 including the updated integration-r5.test.js line 125, and .artifacts/results/impl-offset.r1.json shows 17/17 offset acceptance tests passing. Nothing the spec requires is missing or broken.

r2: spec_conformance re-raised the identical dedupe_key toy/test/offset.test.js|missing-file despite the overruled-findings note in its prompt; a second overrule at the same file trips the repeat guard, so the loop stops instead of buying a third round.

escalated: no code defect is in play — every round's only open finding is the metadata mismatch between spec.touched_surfaces and the task's owned_surfaces, and the fixer owns nothing it may change to clear it.

repeats.claim: Specification requires toy/test/offset.test.js as a touched surface but this file is not created or modified in the diff

decision.note: HE: guide. Lens fix (touched_surfaces is an envelope, not a mandate) in build-implement.js and lens-spec-conformance.md; test file dropped from spec touched_surfaces; re-panel task/impl-offset in verify_only mode.
